answer: Standing decays sharply after 8 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The glacier decay curve is applied at each close, wander records the drop, and pulse recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks as a result finds them worthless when it returns to them. A 98 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
